> Change agent or Git hook integration

1. Treat configuration and stdin as untrusted.
2. Preserve unrelated bytes or structure where practical.
3. Keep installation and removal idempotent.
4. Write backups before changing existing files.
5. Test absent, existing, malformed, custom-path, and repeated operations.
